limits: Finite installed TypeScript workload on native macOS arm64; Local uses OPFS/native mirror, not physical permission checks.
RSS samples at 250ms start after authenticated browser preparation; short and startup peaks may be missed.
RSS union counts shared pages in each process, and includes Chrome/driver tooling. It is not unique physical memory or live allocator heap.
WASM memory capacities are not live Rust allocation. Shared WASM memories are explicitly unsupported.
Post-GC collection adds inspector and collection overhead. Natural RSS is a separate run, with no forced collection.
Local-stage native residency includes still-idle Remote services.
Small retained JS heap trends remain; bounded DOM warmup does not establish complete native or WASM allocator stability.
Idle observations report background language requests; the absence of those requests alone does not isolate all collector or application overhead.
No active-analysis/command-pressure, editor-performance or prefetch-benefit completion claim.
